title: School of Architecture(s) - New Frontiers of Architectural Education
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This open access book gathers the latest advances and innovations in the field of architectural education, as presented at the 2023 annual conference of the European Association for Architectural Education (EAAE AC), “School of Architecture(s)”, held in Turin, Italy, on August 30–September 1, 2023.
